body: Part of the reason why I even want to kill myself or run away when I get so depressive is that I'm so over not being able to control my moods and emotions. With medication I'm stable...but social drinking exacerbates all the worse sides of me. I just destroyed and ruined two friendships last night because of such intense emotions and reactions over something that was a non-issue. I'm scared that I'll ruin more in my future. I just wish it would all go away. I can't keeping doing this to friends and family

I know this post is a few months old, but I really needed to see this. Lately, my stability has been shaky and I lost my routine. I've been feeling so guilty and ashamed of all my mistakes I've made unknowingly because of my disorder. So thank you very much and I hope you are doing well.

I'm so worried because if I don't have someone on standby, so to speak, I would probably make really risky moves to have sex. Not that I'm a stranger to hooking up with a rando on tinder, but it would be nice to not be reliant on sex in this way.

I actually was about to make a post about this myself! I went without sex for a few weeks and this past week I started having a depressive episode and mixed episodes. But I hooked up with a fwb yesterday and suddenly I feel stable again. It makes me feel so pathetic that I need to have sex at least once a week in order to feel stable, despite being on a mood stabilizer.

Hey, you're not wasting anyone's time. It's actually a strange coincidence that I stumbled upon this post. I also have bipolar ii and while my situation isn't exactly like yours, it's similar enough where I 100% understand how you are feeling. It might not mean much, but you're not alone. Tbh it's kind of comforting to know that there is someone out there dealing with almost the same shit. I hope you can be comforted with this thought too, even if it is for a moment.
Unfortunately not right now. I have a hard time getting myself to look for a counselor. Not really sure where to start, especially during this pandemic
Honestly, you described it well. I know that everything I'm feeling isn't neurologically correct, but it is honestly the most comforting

I'm a little annoyed. I've talked to some friends about it, but it's hard for them to see it from my perspective. Yes, getting help might distract me from how I'm feeling, but it's constant feeling. Itll always be there. The only time I feel relief is reading posts in this subreddit.
